parameters.name: Engine
parameters.description: The database engine. Set the value to **MongoDB**.

parameters.name: IsDelete
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the instance is deleted. Valid values:
- **false**: The instance is running. Queries information about running instances.
- **true**: The instance is deleted. Queries information about deleted instances.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group. For more information about resource groups, see [View basic information of a resource group](~~151181~~).
>Currently, only the China site supports this parameter.
